description: Capability for the splash and main windows. The splash listens for backend-status events, invokes current_startup_state to seed the current stage on load (inc 594, backlog #78), and invokes retry_backend; the main window is the real callosum UI, which also listens for update-ready events and invokes install_update_now/open_release_page (the auto-updater, inc 'desktop-shell auto-updater') and open_external_url (open a paper's DOI page etc. in the system browser, inc 589).
